Spare blankets and a hardworking round
Our newest handler discussed something about lighting levels, and the crew cheered
Cabin Comfort at the Companion Animal Travel Desk

This week at Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk kept its focus on calm, careful service and clear handoffs between teams. Staff members continued to guide travelers through crate checks, document review, and comfort planning with a steady and reassuring manner. Safety remains the first priority, and every step is handled with attention to the animal, the booking, and the journey ahead. The senior coordinator reviewed daily decisions and kept the desk aligned with wider service needs.

The most useful reminder for staff is simple: listen closely, explain plainly, and keep the tone warm and professional. Small details matter, from confirming carrier readiness to making sure each pet has what it needs for a smoother trip. Travelers notice when the desk is organized and responsive, and that confidence helps every journey begin well. Companion Animal Travel Desk
